Turning complex engineering and operational tasks from days of work into minutes requires standardizing specialist knowledge into automated pipelines.

OpenAI reports that Oracle uses ChatGPT Work and Codex to build fast, repeatable workflows spanning engineering, operations, and recruiting.

• Oracle integrates ChatGPT Work and Codex across multiple departments.
• The implementation targets recruiting, engineering, and operations.
• The stated goal is to convert days of specialist work into minutes.

Demonstrating how enterprise tools compress multi-day operational cycles into minutes provides a benchmark for evaluating internal team productivity tooling.

Draft a one-page process map for a repetitive engineering task your team handles, then write out a prompt template designed to cut its duration by half. Record the estimated time saved in a spreadsheet log.

Source: OpenAI News

Finding employment after prison remains a massive hurdle, leading founders to build targeted AI platforms for populations left behind by traditional hiring channels.

TechCrunch covers the launch of Commissary Club, an AI-driven employment and social platform founded by Richard Bronson to help ex-cons find jobs, housing, and community.

• Founder Richard Bronson partnered with technical co-founder Roman Kissin to build the platform.
• The site offers job search assistance, housing resources, a community forum, and dating features.
• The platform offers the first ten applications free before switching to a paid per-application fee model.

Targeting overlooked demographic segments with specialized technical workflows opens up distinct startup market opportunities that general platforms ignore.

Sketch a wireframe for a niche job board focused on a specific specialized skill set, defining the exact data fields needed for candidate profiles. Save the wireframe as an image file and verify that the user dashboard displays all required metadata clearly.

Source: TechCrunch
